title: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston’s skid to 5
author: The Associated Press
bullets: The Toronto Blue Jays scored five runs in the eighth inning to defeat the Boston Red Sox 6-4.
The Red Sox have now lost five consecutive games, matching their longest losing streak of the season.
Blue Jays pitcher José Soriano gave up one run over six innings, while Luis Varland earned his 26th save.

title: Allston-Brighton residents divided over future of Jackson Mann Community Center, survey shows
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Survey shows Allston-Brighton residents split on whether Jackson Mann Community Center should include housing, a school, or both.
City survey revealed 190 respondents preferred housing, 171 favored a school, and 124 supported combining both in redevelopment.
Mayor Michelle Wu to decide on redevelopment options by year's end; new survey open until September 10 for more input.

title: Tour the Patriots’ new 160,000-square-foot training facility
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The New Balance Athletics Center is a 160,000-square-foot facility for the Patriots, located next to Gillette Stadium.
The facility includes a 15,000-square-foot weight room, virtual reality room, and a spacious locker room with 92 lockers.
It features a hydrotherapy room, players' lounge, dining area, and space for future modifications and staffing expansions.

title: Man killed in stabbing inside South Station during rush hour, officials say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A man was fatally stabbed inside South Station around 5:33 p.m. during rush hour on Wednesday.
The victim was involved in an altercation on an escalator and later died at a local hospital, police reported.
Police are seeking a male suspect still at large and are reviewing video evidence and interviewing witnesses.

title: Body found at TD Garden, police say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Boston police found a deceased person near TD Garden Wednesday evening at 100 Legends Way.
The body was reportedly found inside a parking garage adjacent to TD Garden.
The incident is under investigation, with police handling further inquiries.

title: Athol man charged with child pornography possession
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Kristopher Ambrozewicz, 35, of Athol, charged with possession of child sexual abuse materials, served as a youth soccer referee.
Federal prosecutors found several videos of child sexual abuse material on his cell phone during a home search.
He faces up to 20 years in prison and potential fines, with arraignment scheduled in Worcester Federal Court on Thursday.

title: Police: Person held pregnant woman hostage with gun during dramatic chase on I-93 in Milton
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A pregnant woman was held hostage with a gun during a police chase on I-93 North in Milton.
Suspect Dominic Hampton-Boyd, 31, crashed into eight vehicles before fleeing on foot and being arrested.
Medical care was provided to the victim, but details of her injuries remain undisclosed.

title: Stoughton town manager contradicts police chief who accused him of tampering with Sandra Birchmore investigation
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Stoughton Town Manager Thomas Calter refutes harassment and investigation interference claims by Police Chief Donna McNamara.
McNamara accuses Calter of pressuring her to destroy an internal report on Sandra Birchmore investigation.
Calter and McNamara are on paid leave amid ongoing legal and administrative inquiries into the allegations.

title: Nearly 30 people arrested after investigation into drug trafficking in Western Mass.
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Twenty-eight people were arrested after a drug trafficking investigation in Chicopee, Holyoke, and Springfield, Massachusetts.
Authorities seized over 12 firearms, more than one kilogram of cocaine, numerous fentanyl pills, and heroin.
The investigation, "Operation Pinky Promise," involved federal, state, and local law enforcement and included wiretaps and controlled purchases.

title: Patriots stock watch 2.0: Who’s rising and falling ahead of preseason opener?
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots rookie Drake Maye displayed sharp performance in joint practices against Colts, despite an interception.
Wide receiver DeMario Douglas showed versatility during practices, contributing significantly with contested catches and quick routes.
Backup QB Tommy DeVito impressed with deep throws, stepping into the backup role with a strong arm and confidence.
